team.name: Dr Sheena Parmar
team.title: Clinical Psychologist

image.alt: Dr Sheena Parmar, Clinical Psychologist, smiling and seated on a sofa

team.focus: EMDR accredited · 15+ years in the NHS
team.lead: A safe, compassionate, non-judgemental space where you can build insight, feel empowered and make meaningful change.
team.about: Sheena is a highly experienced Clinical Psychologist with over 15 years supporting people with a wide range of mental health and wellbeing difficulties. Her background is primarily within the NHS, where she developed expertise in complex mental and physical health conditions. She now works full-time in private practice, offering evidence-based, tailored support, and also enjoys working with teams and organisations.

testimonial.quote: Sheena has been very helpful and helped me to regain my confidence… I felt finally able to talk about it all and learned great skills to manage my anxiety.

team.name: Dr Sanchia Biswas
team.title: Clinical Psychologist

image.alt: Dr Sanchia Biswas, Clinical Psychologist, smiling and seated in a softly lit room

team.lead: Working collaboratively with you to discover the fulfilment of living life by your values.
team.about: Sanchia is a Clinical Psychologist working in Nottinghamshire. She has largely worked within adult mental health services in the NHS and is highly experienced with people of all ages and their families. Alongside common mental health difficulties, she particularly specialises in adult mental health in the context of physical health, which is also the focus of her research interests.
team.worksWith: People of all ages, and their families

testimonial.quote: I immediately felt safe to explore my memories with Sanchia… the EMDR itself has honestly been incredible for me personally, removing much anxiety, doubt and trauma.

team.name: Dr Harry Ager
team.title: Clinical Psychologist

image.alt: Dr Harry Ager, Clinical Psychologist, smiling in a shirt and jacket

team.lead: Bringing exercise and nutrition into therapy to support your mental wellbeing as a whole.
team.about: Harry is a Clinical Psychologist with extensive NHS and private sector experience in adult mental health, forensic and rehabilitation settings. He works with people across the lifespan with common mental health difficulties, including neurodivergent people, and particularly specialises in substance misuse and psychosis. As a qualified personal trainer, he can integrate exercise and nutrition into your therapy.

testimonial.quote: I was slightly apprehensive of the unknown before my first appointment, but I was put completely at ease within minutes… I look back now and realise the dramatic improvement this has made to my quality of life.
